description: This file defines an abstract base class 'ConditionPluginBase' for condition plugins in Drupal, providing common functionality such as configuration management, execution, and context handling.

classes.name: ConditionPluginBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing a base implementation for condition plugins, including configuration, execution, and context management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with configuration, plugin ID, and plugin definition.

methods.name: isNegated
methods.description: Checks if the condition is negated based on configuration.

methods.name: buildConfigurationForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for the plugin, including context mapping and negation checkbox.

methods.name: validateConfigurationForm
methods.description: Placeholder for validating the configuration form.

methods.name: submitConfigurationForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, saving negation state and context mapping.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the condition via the executable manager.

methods.name: getConfiguration
methods.description: Returns the current configuration, including plugin ID.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates dependencies; returns an empty array by default.
